items: Skills check: every skill and agent that calls UEFN MCP tools now sends the AI to the proven recipes (14 of 35 skills and 11 of 22 agents; the others do not use MCP tools). Two were missing: `verse-ui-kit` now points to `uefn-ui-widgets` and the recipes, and `planner-docs` reads the level devices through the level-devices recipes instead of an old tool name.
release.title: v1.107.4 — Skills point to the proven recipes
